name: Talim AI
tagline: AI self-learning platform that turns any material into an interactive lesson
role: Our own product — design, AI and full-stack engineering

scenes.title: Turn anything into a lesson
scenes.body: Drop in a PDF, slide deck or YouTube link — Talim builds the course around it.

scenes.title: Every source, split into sections
scenes.body: The AI segments the material and tracks mastery section by section.

scenes.title: A tutor grounded in your material
scenes.body: Retrieval-augmented answers come from your own sources — not the whole internet.

scenes.title: Quizzes and live games
scenes.body: Generated quizzes and live game sessions with a class leaderboard.

scenes.title: A dashboard for schools and tutors
scenes.body: Rosters, join codes, assessments and progress for every learner.

scenes.title: From free to school plans
scenes.body: Individual, tutor and school tiers with monthly or annual billing.
